# New renderings — odyssey-110 (22.398–501)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| ἀγραύλοιο (22.403, of an ox) | "field-dwelling" | "field-dwelling" | "of the fields", "from the fields", "farm-bred", "stalled", "domestic"; follows the shipped βοὸς ἀγραύλοιο "field-dwelling ox" (12.251, odyssey-059) and ἄγραυλοι πόριες (10.410, odyssey-049); from ἀγρός "field" + αὐλή |
| λύθρος (22.402, αἵματι καὶ λύθρῳ) | "gore" | "gore" | "filth", "grime", "dirt" |
| πεπαλαγμένος / πεπάλακτο (22.402, 22.406) | "spattered" | "spattered" | "stained", "smeared", "befouled" |
| ὀλολύζω (22.408, 22.411) | "raise the ritual cry" | "raise the ritual cry" | "cry out in triumph" (that is the shipped `i` of ἐπευχόμενος "in triumph", 22.286), "shout", "wail", "ululate"; follows the wording shipped for ὀλόλυξε at 4.767 (odyssey-021) |
| ἄσπετος (22.407, ἄσπετον αἷμα) | "boundless" | "boundless" | "unspeakable", "beyond telling" (shipped only in the early odyssey-014 and odyssey-023), "immense" (reserved for ἀθέσφατος), "vast"; follows the table's ἄσπετα κρέα, ἄσπετον οὖδας, κλαγγὴ ἄσπετος and ἄσπετον (22.269) |
| εὐχετάομαι (22.412) | "boast" | "boast" | "exult", "vaunt" (shipped `l` of ἐπευχόμενος, 22.286), "pray"; the table's εὐχετόωνται "declare" (12.98) is the other sense, "claim", with an infinitive of what is claimed; here ἐπί + dative "over" makes it the boast |
| νηλείτις (22.418, νηλείτιδες) | "guiltless" | "guiltless" (+ note: rare; traditional gloss) | "innocent", "blameless" (reserved for ἀμύμων) |
| ἀναιδείη (22.424) | "shamelessness" | "shamelessness" | "impudence", "insolence" |
| δουλοσύνη (22.423) | "slavery" | "slavery" | "servitude", "drudgery" |
| ξαίνω (22.423, of wool) | "card" | "card" | "comb", "tease", "spin" |
| πολύτρητος (22.439, 22.453, of sponges) | "full-of-holes" | "many-holed" | "porous", "perforated", "spongy"; follows the wording shipped for σπόγγοισι πολυτρήτοισι at 1.109 (odyssey-002) |
| θόλος (22.442, 22.459, 22.466) | "the tholos" | "the round building" (+ note: a round building with a conical roof) | "the rotunda", "the dome", "the round house" |
| ψυχή of the living (22.444) | "lives" | "lives" | "souls" (reserved for the souls of the dead), "breath" |
| ἀολλέες (22.446) | "all together" | "all together" | "in a body", "crowded"; "in a throng" and "in throngs" are shipped for the same word at odyssey-018 and odyssey-053 and stand as shipped |
| αἴνα (22.447, αἴν’ ὀλοφυρόμεναι) | "terribly" | "terribly" | "bitterly", "fearsomely" (kept for αἰνο-compounds in `l`), "loudly" |
| λίστρον (22.455) | "scraper" | "scraper" | "shovel", "spade", "hoe" |
| ἐν στείνει (22.460) | "in a narrow place" | "in a narrow place" | "in a confined space", "in a tight spot" |
| πεῖσμα (22.465) | "cable" | "cable" | "rope" (reserved for σχοινίον; shipped as "a rope" at 10.166, odyssey-046, a standing inconsistency), "hawser", "mooring-line"; follows the shipped "cables" (πείσματα, 6.268, 10.95, 10.125) |
| κίχλη · πέλεια (22.468) | "thrush" · "dove" | "thrush" · "dove" | "fieldfare", "pigeon" for πέλεια; the species of both are not known |
| στυγερὸς κοῖτος (22.470) | "a hateful resting-place" | "a hateful resting-place" | "a hateful bed" (reserved for λέχος), "a hateful roost", "a hateful lodging" |
| ἑξείης (22.471) | "in a row" | "in a row" | "one after another"; "in order" is shipped for guests taking their seats (1.144, 3.388) and is kept for that sense |
| ἀσπαίρω (22.473, ἤσπαιρον) | "twitched" | "twitched" | "gasped", "kicked", "writhed"; ἀσπαίροντα of a fish is shipped as "gasping" (12.251, odyssey-059), where the gasping is of the whole creature; here the feet twitch |
| ῥῖνες (22.475, ῥῖνάς) | "the nose" | "his nose" | "his nostrils" (plural kept out of English; shipped "nostrils" at 5.455, odyssey-026, where ῥῖνας stands beside the mouth) |
| θέειον · θήϊον (22.481, 22.493) | "sulphur" | "sulphur" | "brimstone", "disinfectant"; follows the table's θέειον "sulphur" (12.417) |
| θεειόω · διαθειόω (22.482 θεειώσω, 22.494 διεθείωσεν) | "purify with sulphur" / "purified with sulphur" | "purify the hall with sulphur" / "purified … with the sulphur" | "fumigate" (modern register), "cleanse" (reserved for καθαίρω) |
| ἄκος (22.481, κακῶν ἄκος) | "remedy" | "cure" | "healing", "antidote" |
| ῥάκος (22.488, ῥάκεσιν) | "rags" | "rags" | "tatters", "scraps" |
| νεμεσσητός (22.489) | "a thing to resent" | "a cause for resentment" | "shameful", "improper"; keeps the table's νεμεσσάω "resentment" |
| ἀμφιχέομαι (22.498, ἀμφεχέοντο) | "poured themselves about" | "flung themselves round" | "embraced", "crowded round", "clung to" |
| αἴνυμαι (22.500, αἰνύμεναι) | "clasping" | "clasping" | "taking" (shipped for αἰνυμένους of cheeses, 9.224, odyssey-041; with hands as the object "clasping" is the sense), "seizing", "grasping" |
| γλυκὺς ἵμερος κλαυθμοῦ καὶ στοναχῆς (22.500–501) | "sweet longing for weeping and groaning" | "a sweet longing for weeping and groaning" | "urge to weep", "desire for tears", "bitter longing" |
